facts.text: Caroline shared her transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community during a school event last week.

evidence.quote: I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! I talked about my transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community.
You've come a long way since your transition - keep on inspiring people with your strength and courage!

facts.text: Caroline expressed gratitude for the support she has received throughout her transition and aims to pass it on to others.

evidence.quote: I've been blessed with loads of love and support throughout this journey, and I want to pass it on to others.

facts.text: Melanie acknowledged Caroline's bravery in speaking up for the trans community and praised her for inspiring others.

evidence.quote: You're so brave to speak up for the trans community.
Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing!

facts.text: Melanie emphasized the importance of sharing personal stories to foster understanding and support within the trans community.

evidence.quote: It's in these vulnerable moments that we bond and understand each other. Our stories can be so inspiring and encouraging to others who are facing the same challenges.
